title.zh: 授权为调整私立学校局各处处长、督学、视导及其他人员的薪金拨款72000比索的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of the Sum of Seventy-Two Thousand Pesos for the Adjustment of the Salaries of Chiefs of Divisions, Superintendents, Supervisors, and Other Personnel of the Bureau of Private Schools
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of the Sum of Seventy-Two Thousand Pesos for the Adjustment of the Salaries of Chiefs of Divisions, Superintendents, Supervisors, and Other Personnel of the Bureau of Private Schools

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1950/ra_536_1950.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of seventy-two thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated to carry out the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Three hundred twelve for adjustment of the salaries of chiefs of divisions, superintendents, supervisors, and other personnel of the Bureau of Private Schools.

This Act shall take effect as of July 1948.
Approved, June 16, 1950.
